basic_info.description: Step into modern elegance with this exquisite top-floor condominium in San Francisco's gem of a neighborhood, Little Hollywood. Built in 2008, this two-level residence blends contemporary sophistication with effortless comfort. The first floor features an expansive and light-filled, highly coveted open floor plan layout with a rich wood floor, a cozy gas fireplace, and a striking vaulted living and dining area showcasing views of the Bay and San Bruno Mountains. The gourmet kitchen offers sleek stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and a design perfect for entertaining and culinary creations. Two spacious bedrooms, a full bathroom, and conveniently located side by side washer/dryer complete this level. Upstairs, the primary suite provides a tranquil retreat with a sitting area and private terrace offering peek-a-boo views of the city. The spa-like ensuite includes a walk-in shower, shower-over-tub, and dual vanities. An additional bedroom, ideal for a home office or nursery, boasts its own private terrace with stunning views of the Bay and South San Francisco's rolling hills. With 1-car parking and proximity to Caltrain, MUNI, SFO, and major highways, this home offers refined living at its finest.
